## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-7: Idempotency verified by re-running CI on same commit_sha — SHORT_CIRCUIT activates, no duplicates.

Re-trigger the llm-review workflow on the same commit_sha exercised in task-2 (no new push, no rebase — use `gh run rerun` against the existing workflow run, OR `gh workflow run llm-review --ref <branch>` if rerun is unavailable). After the re-run reaches a terminal state, confirm:
  - cycle_dispatcher logged a SHORT_CIRCUIT activation (visible in workflow logs).
  - No new DEFER orphan tickets created beyond task-2's baseline (the orphan ticket count for tag `orphan:deferred_review` AND `origin:arbiter` is unchanged).
  - No new DROP defense records appended to the GitHub PR store beyond task-2's `drop_defense_count` baseline.
  - No duplicate arbiter PR comment posted — still exactly one `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>` marker for the scenario commit_sha.
The orphan-ticket-count delta and defense-record-count delta are the load-bearing signals — both MUST be zero. dd-7 says 'no duplicates' — the AC enforces that literally.

Note on test exemption: test-exempt — observational re-run of shipped runtime; the cycle dispatcher SHORT_CIRCUIT path is already covered by the fixture-replay harness named in task-1.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Universal (always run):**
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Tests pass
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh

**Task-specific (resolves PR # and baseline counts from task-1/task-2 progress notes; baseline fallback via direct GitHub API):**
- [ ] Re-trigger executed on same commit_sha (no new push; `gh run rerun` against existing workflow run)
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show fdf4-b53c-c692-44bf 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'rerun_workflow_run_id: [0-9]+'
- [ ] SHORT_CIRCUIT activated in workflow logs
  Verify: RERUN_ID=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show fdf4-b53c-c692-44bf | grep -oE 'rerun_workflow_run_id: [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}'); gh run view $RERUN_ID --log 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'SHORT_CIRCUIT'
- [ ] dd-7: Orphan-ticket-count delta is ZERO (task-2 baseline; if absent, query API directly)
  Verify: BASELINE=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 | grep -oE 'orphan_count_baseline: [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}'); BASELINE=${BASELINE:-$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --tag=orphan:deferred_review 2>/dev/null | wc -l)}; AFTER=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --tag=orphan:deferred_review 2>/dev/null | wc -l); [ "$BASELINE" -eq "$AFTER" ]
- [ ] dd-7: Arbiter PR comment count still exactly 1 (no duplicate)
  Verify: PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/issues/$PR_NUM/comments --jq '[.[] | select(.body | test("DSO-Arbiter-Ruling:"))] | length' | grep -q '^1$'
- [ ] dd-7: DROP defense record count unchanged from task-2 baseline
  Verify: BASELINE=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 | grep -oE 'drop_defense_count: [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}'); PR_NUM=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show 8304-b0e1-c112-4f07 | grep -oE 'PR: #[0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+'); AFTER=$(gh api repos/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/issues/$PR_NUM/comments --jq '[.[] | select(.body | test("DEFENSE_RECORD.*dropped_by_arbiter"))] | length'); [ "$BASELINE" -eq "$AFTER" ]
